## Release Notes

<!-- ANCHOR: changelog -->

### Changed

- Use a single unicode character for checkboxes
- Support compressed responses
  - brotli, deflate, gzip, and zstd content encodings are now supported
  - Slumber will not include a `Content-Encoding` header by default; if you want your responses to be compressed, you'll have to manually add the request header
- Include database path in TUI Help page

### Fixed

- Fixed underflow in hotkey hint [#767](https://github.com/LucasPickering/slumber/pull/767) (@MichaelXavier)

## Install slumber 5.4.0

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/LucasPickering/slumber/releases/download/v5.4.0/slumber-installer.sh | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```sh
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://github.com/LucasPickering/slumber/releases/download/v5.4.0/slumber-installer.ps1 | iex"
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via Homebrew

```sh
brew install LucasPickering/tap/slumber
```
